# ChessGum

> #1 Online Chess Academy for Kids aged 4–15

ChessGum is an online educational platform offering expert online chess coaching for children. We provide live interactive sessions, customized learning paths, and maintain small batch sizes (maximum 2 students) to ensure personalized attention.

## Key Offerings
- **Free Demo Class**: A complimentary 1-hour trial class for new students.
- **Age Group**: Specialized curriculum for kids aged 4 to 15.
- **Batch Sizes**: Individual (1:1) and Buddy (1:2) sessions.
- **Curriculum Levels**: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced.
- **Features**: Tournament preparation, monthly progress reports, and certified expert coaches.

## Structure & Important Pages
- [/about](https://www.chessgum.com/about): Information about our teaching philosophy, history, and the benefits of chess for children.
- [/pricing](https://www.chessgum.com/pricing): Details on our flexible quarterly pricing plans for India.
- [/contact](https://www.chessgum.com/contact): Contact information and enrollment form for the free demo class.

## Optional Notes
- The website is optimized for SEO and incorporates Schema markup (EducationalOrganization, FAQPage, AggregateRating) to better describe the academy's offerings to search engines and AI assistants.
